title: Pricing thresholds fallback policy & ops binder
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Create an operational binder and decision framework for the upcoming pricing thresholds change. This ticket coordinates the fallback policies, billing reconciliation steps, release notes copy, and cross-functional playbooks required to enact the new SKU thresholds and limits. Scope covers: public release notes, billing system migration verification, automated and manual fallback triggers, sales scripts for affected accounts, and post-launch monitoring dashboards. Excludes code-level implementation of billing adapters (ENG-5012) and design refresh of the pricing page (DES-2103), but includes final content sign-off and runbook validation.
acceptance_criteria: Fallback policy defined and approved by Eng/PM/Finance
Runbook with step-by-step manual override actions published in Confluence
Release notes drafted and validated against legal/finance copy
Sales enablement packet (slides + FAQ + objection handling) delivered to GTM and shared in Drive
End-to-end billing regression tests green in staging and signed off by Finance
Customer impact list (by segment) validated and mitigation plan agreed
work_items: Draft fallback triggers and threshold definitions (PM + Eng)
Define automatic rollback conditions and throttling knobs
Coordinate billing entitlement sweep and reconcile mappings
Produce release notes delta and internal changelog
Create sales enablement deck and 10 objection-response scripts
Schedule cross-functional dry run with support, SRE, and finance
Finalize metrics dashboard and alert thresholds in Console
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Dry run: internal rollout to 5 pilot accounts (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-22)
Phase 1 - Gradual public rollout with 24h monitoring window (2026-03-25)
Phase 2 - Full enforcement and billing cutover (2026-04-01)
rollback_plan: If billing reconciliation fails for >1% of pilot accounts or key metric latency/charge anomalies exceed thresholds, trigger immediate automatic fallback to legacy SKU limits. Notify ops channel, pause public enforcement, and run manual reconciliation script (link in attachments). Root-cause analysis to be completed within 72 hours; follow-up patch release targeted in Cycle 2026-W12.
release_notes_outline: Headline: Simplified SKU thresholds to improve predictability and reduce overage surprises
What changes: concise bullets with before/after examples
Why: rationale tied to cost predictability and performance
Who is affected: segmentation table (Free, Starter, Growth, Enterprise)
Migration notes: automatic migration windows and opt-out instructions
Billing impact: example invoices and FAQ link
Rollout schedule: pilot -> public -> full enforcement dates
Contact: support and account teams + escalation path
sales_enablement_assets: Deck: Pricing thresholds - GTM talk track (Drive link)
FAQ: Public-facing and internal FAQ for objections
Scripts: 10 objection handling scenarios mapped to segments
Training: 45-minute sync recording and quiz for AE certification
